name: International Protection (UNHCR Mandate Refugee Status Determination)

requirements.blocker_text: Must establish a well-founded fear of persecution in the country of origin to a UNHCR-conducted mandate refugee status determination interview.

sources.title: UNHCR Northern and Eastern Caribbean -- Apply for asylum through UNHCR: Sint Maarten (Dutch part) is explicitly listed among the territories where UNHCR (via its regional office) conducts mandate refugee status determination at the request of the government, since no domestic asylum system exists locally

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Sint Maarten's initial build. Sint Maarten has NO domestic asylum/refugee-status-determination law or agency -- per this tier-2 UNHCR source, it is grouped with Anguilla, Antigua and Barbuda, Barbados, Bermuda, the British Virgin Islands, Dominica, Grenada, Haiti, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines as places where UNHCR itself conducts mandate refugee status determination, rather than any Sint Maarten ministry (contrasted with the Bahamas, Cayman Islands, Jamaica, Montserrat, and Turks and Caicos Islands, where local governments handle asylum directly, per the same UNHCR source used for Turks and Caicos earlier this session). Notably, Sint Maarten's Kingdom siblings Aruba and Curacao were NOT modelled with a humanitarian route this session -- for those, multiple Amnesty International/Refugees International reports specifically documented denial of protection to Venezuelan asylum seekers, so the finding was disclosed rather than built as a route. No equivalent specific finding was located for Sint Maarten in this pass -- absence of a negative finding is not evidence the system works well, simply that no equivalent report was found; modelled as DRAFT (tier-2 sourcing, no confirmation of what local legal status follows a positive determination) rather than excluded, consistent with how Antigua and Barbuda's, the BVI's, and Bermuda's equivalent routes were treated. work_rights, study_rights, and family_can_join are conservatively modelled as none/false pending that gap being closed.
